sources.title: GitHub - Vita0818/Agent7
sources.snippet: Overview 概述 Agent7 is a system-level agent that lets an LLM (DeepSeek / Qwen / Kimi) observe and control your iPhone. Given a natural language task, it plans, executes actions (open apps, paste text, open URLs, take screenshots), verifies results, and adapts — running as a daemon with a companion UIKit app.
